images.prompt: A small gray mountain with a white snowcap behind a winding dark path and three green pine trees, seen from a quiet open meadow on a pale overcast day. Photorealistic camera photograph of a fictional independently generated scene. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280 or larger. Natural material and light. No artwork, text, brands, logos, borders or watermark.

review.reason: The natural photograph contains three distinct trees, a clear winding trail and one snowcapped mountain with coherent depth and no labels or unrelated subjects.

images.actual_source_analysis: A narrow dark gravel path bends from the lower center through a green rocky meadow toward a central gray mountain with a white snowcap. Three distinct conifers stand across the middle ground: one tall at left, one shorter center-right and one medium at right. A pale overcast sky fills the upper background; scattered stones lie in the foreground.
